newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ayala group acquires Sydney building.
newsitem.headline: Ayala group acquires Sydney building.

text.p: Philippine conglomerate the Ayala group said on Wednesday it recently acquired the 16-storey Tattersall's building, a prime office building located in the Sydney central business district fronting Hyde Park.
Ayala bought the building from Sheraton on the Park Pty Ltd, a unit of ITT Corp /Sheraton, but terms of the acquisition were not disclosed in a statement to the Philippine Stock Exchange.
The company said the purchase represents the Ayala group's first investment in Australia.
The Ayala group said the purchase was done through the Australian unit of 50-percent owned Ayala International Properties Pte Ltd.
It said the purchase of the building was part of its moves to diversify in the region. It already has property ventures in Indonesia and Singapore.
